turns.question: Which customer opened the most CRM emails between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many did they open?
turns.answer: No customer stands out: customers 1, 4 and 9 are tied, each with 1 email open (customer actions of type email_open) from 20 September to 3 October 2026, and they are the only customers with any.
